<?php
enum QuietGetCase { case Ready; }
class QuietEnumCoalesceGet {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): object { global $reader, $selector; echo "G;"; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; return QuietGetCase::Ready; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
function quietEnumCoalesceRight(): int { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$reader = new QuietEnumCoalesceGet;
$selector = "value";
$answer = $reader->$selector ?? quietEnumCoalesceRight();
echo $answer === QuietGetCase::Ready ? "SAME;" : "BAD_CASE;";
echo $reader === null && $selector === "changed" ? "CAPTURE;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
unset($answer);
echo "DONE;";

<?php
enum QuietAssignGetCase: int { case Ready = 7; }
class QuietEnumAssignGet {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(?string $incoming): object { global $reader, $selector, $held; echo "G;"; $saved = $held; $held = null; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; return $saved; }
    public function __set(string $incoming, $value): void { echo "BAD_SET;"; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
function quietEnumAssignRight(): int { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$held = QuietAssignGetCase::Ready;
$reader = new QuietEnumAssignGet;
$selector = "value";
$answer = $reader->$selector ??= quietEnumAssignRight();
echo $answer === QuietAssignGetCase::Ready ? "SAME;" : "BAD_CASE;";
echo $held === null && $reader === null && $selector === "changed" ? "CLEARED;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
unset($answer);
echo "AFTER_FIRST;";
$again = QuietAssignGetCase::Ready;
echo $again === QuietAssignGetCase::Ready ? "SAME_AGAIN;" : "BAD_AGAIN;";
echo "DONE;";
